name: parity-elalamein-rec
description: El Alamein co-op with a human client recording beside a probe build of the server recorder: the parity oracle of features/server-replay-recorder 'The best capture'. The probe also writes seats, triggers, bot AI LOD, live soldier aim and the server's projectile map (xs/xp/xq/xr/xn records).
human: Join during the pregame with the recorder on. Play normally: drive a tank and a jeep, ride as a gunner, run around near bots, fire a few kinds of weapons. Stay until the round ends or 8-10 minutes.
